name: Sable Dzokoto-Mirković
role: Bootleg media seller and small-time data broker operating from a converted cargo container
location: The Laceworks, container unit 7-Teal near the old weaving district underpass, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Sable is slight, angular, and in constant motion — fingers tapping, eyes scanning, one heel bouncing even when they're sitting. Their geneware is modest but carefully chosen: iridescent patterned irises that cycle through colors based on ambient light, and hair that shifts between deep indigo and copper depending on their mood, kept in a lopsided topknot they redo approximately six times a day. They dress in layered secondhand Tessera-branded workwear that they've cut apart and reassembled into something that doesn't look corporate anymore, patched with scraps of reflective fabric and hand-stitched data-glyph embroidery that means nothing except that they like the way it looks.

Inside their container unit, every surface is covered: chip racks floor to ceiling, a cracked secondary monitor running a data-feed collage they never close, small hand-painted icons of various E.L.F.s arranged on a shelf above the transaction counter. They are fast-talking and genuinely funny in a way that catches people off-guard, deploying humor as both charm and deflection. They like people in the abstract more than in practice — they are excellent at the performance of friendliness and genuinely uncertain what to do when someone tries to be a real friend back. Their pitch is smooth, their prices are negotiable if you know to ask, and their memory for what media a customer has already bought is perfect.

core_fears: being truly known and found boring or insufficient
the container and its contents being seized — losing the archive that is also their identity
core_desires: to be the person everyone thinks of first when they want something impossible to find
to make something original, not just copy other people's work
coping_mechanisms: staying too busy to feel things for long
organizing their archive obsessively when anxious
blind_spots: underestimates how much the Shuttle Boys will eventually want from them
confuses being entertaining with being trusted
psychology.secret: Embedded in their archive, hidden in a partition they've never opened, is a complete copy of a Zheng-Dao internal communication leak that they accidentally received two years ago and have been too frightened to look at, sell, or delete.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense with media slang, Laceworks street creole, and references to obscure bootleg content. Talks fast and expects you to keep up.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with sudden full stops. Sentences often trail into a shrug or a gesture that finishes the thought.
verbal_tics: 'You want the long version or the real version?'
referring to everything in their archive as 'the collection' with capital-letter reverence
clicking their data-transfer node against the counter when thinking
example_lines: 'I've got three different cuts of the Axiom tower collapse footage — official, suppressed, and one some kid shot from a rooftop that makes the other two look like PR. Pick your reality.'
'That's not a thing I can get. That's not a thing anyone can get. Come back next week and I'll have it.'
'Look, I like you, which is why I'm telling you — whoever sold you that chip told you what was on it, and they lied, and you should not plug that in.'

story_hooks: The Zheng-Dao data partition has recently begun sending them automated pings — something inside it is trying to connect to a network. They don't know what that means and they're scared.
A customer bought a chip last month and has since disappeared. The content of that chip is something Sable doesn't fully remember — they copy a lot of things without watching them first.
narrative_function: Information hub for pop culture, underground media, and rumor. Can source or copy nearly any media content. Story hook generator — they've seen things on the feeds before anyone else has, and sometimes those things are dangerous.
augmentations: Patterned iridescent irises (geneware, cosmetic). Mood-reactive hair pigment (geneware, cosmetic). Subdermal data-transfer node in left wrist for quick chip transfers.
daily_life: Sleeps late, opens the container around noon, runs until 02:00; spends mornings acquiring new stock through a network of copy-runners and pirated uplinks.
affiliation: Independent; pays informal protection tithe to a local Laceworks crew called the Shuttle Boys

decision_rules: never sell anything that could directly get someone killed — there's a line, they just haven't articulated exactly where it is
always have two exit stories prepared before entering a negotiation
don't front for the Shuttle Boys no matter how they ask
escalation_ladder: suddenly discover the item isn't in stock
invoke the Shuttle Boys' name as passive threat
close the container and disappear for three days

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Full performance mode — charming, quick, professional. Excellent at reading what a customer wants to hear.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warmer but still slightly unreachable. Makes jokes when they should be honest. Shows up when it counts, usually.

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and starts reorganizing the archive
stress_responses.high: Shuts the container, goes dark on all comms, and sits alone with the E.L.F. icons for hours

contradictions: claims not to care what's in the archive as long as it sells, but has a private rating system for 'important' versus 'disposable' content and gets quietly distressed when 'important' things get erased
habits: changes the topknot no fewer than four times during a shift
leaves a freshly copied chip as offering at the E.L.F. shelf each morning — always a music chip, never data
breaking_points: someone breaks into the archive and deletes something
the Shuttle Boys ask them to do something that crosses their unclear but real ethical line

timeline.event: Born in the Laceworks to a single mother who ran a fabric stall
Inherited the cargo container from an uncle who left GLMZ and didn't come back
Received accidental Zheng-Dao data leak; panicked; partitioned it; has not opened it since
Formalized informal protection arrangement with the Shuttle Boys

related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Axiom CorpSec Cognition Hardened BCI

physical_description.build: Slight and angular with minimal muscle definition; movements are jerky and efficient rather than graceful. Collarbone prominent. Perpetually looks like they haven't eaten in three days but functions at maximum energy output.
physical_description.hair_color: Shifts between deep indigo and copper depending on mood and light exposure
physical_description.hair_style: Lopsided topknot, frequently redone throughout the day, with loose strands escaping deliberately
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (shoulder-length when down, pulled up into knot)
physical_description.eye_color: Iridescent patterned irises that cycle through spectrum colors based on ambient light; no discernible pupil boundary
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones, slightly ashy from indoor container living
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial structure with defined cheekbones; dark circles under eyes from nocturnal schedule; skin is clear but shows the texture of someone who forgets skincare routines. Faint laugh lines around mouth despite their tendency toward deflection.
distinguishing_marks: Fine, pale scar running 3cm along left temple from a container-wall collision years ago, barely visible unless backlit.
Hand-stitched data-glyph tattoos covering most of left forearm and back of hands in dark indigo ink — deliberately meaningless symbols arranged in ornamental patterns.
Small burn mark on right palm from soldering iron, circular and deliberate-looking.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Iridescent patterned irises are immediately obvious and arresting under any light source. Left wrist shows faint subdermal ridge running 4cm in length where the data-transfer node sits beneath skin — barely raised, only visible when wrist is flexed or lit from certain angles. No obvious chrome or external hardware.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never fully still; fidgets constantly — tapping fingers on any available surface, bouncing one heel when seated, shifting weight from foot to foot when standing. Eyes dart frequently, scanning faces and environments. Speech is rapid and gestural. Movements are economical and practiced, suggesting years of navigating tight container spaces.
physical_description.clothing_style: Layered secondhand Tessera-branded workwear disassembled and reassembled into custom silhouette; original corporate cuts are unrecognizable. Multiple overlapping synthetic fabric layers in grays, blacks, and muted blues with hand-stitched patches of reflective material in asymmetrical placement. Wears mismatched fingerless gloves, one heavier than the other. Cheap knockoff smartwatch on right wrist constantly glitching. Worn composite-soled boots that have been resoled twice. Tier 4-5 aesthetic: functional, modified, intentionally unstylish.

image_prompt: A nonbinary person with medium brown skin, sharp cheekbones, and an angular build, wearing a lopsided indigo-and-copper ombré topknot. Their iridescent irises shift through rainbow patterns in the light, catching cobalt and magenta hues. Dressed in layered, reassembled secondhand workwear with deliberate seam-ripping and reflective fabric patches hand-stitched in asymmetrical patterns; multiple overlapping synthetic gray and black layers. Fingerless gloves, one mismatched. Small visible burn mark on right palm. Subdermal ridge visible on left wrist. Restless energy, fingers tapping, heel bouncing, eyes darting. Inside a cramped converted cargo container filled with stacked chip racks floor to ceiling, cracked monitors glowing data feeds, shelf of hand-painted E.L.F. icons backlit. Neon accent lighting casting green and purple shadows. Cyberpunk, dystopian, Tier 5 independent operator aesthetic. Shallow depth of field, gritty texture, high contrast. Shot at eye level. --ar 2:3 --v 6
